subject: Battlefield
text: Beat 10 rounds of monsters at battlefields to win prizes or EXP and GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefields are places on the world map in which you can fight
            monsters. Beat 10 rounds of them, and you can win prizes or EXP
            and GP.

How many battlefields are there?

        [A] There are 20 in all.

subject: Refresher
text: Refreshers will regain any stats lost in-battle.

evidence.quote: Refreshers will regain any stats lost in-battle.

subject: Dark King
text: Casting Cure on the Dark King easily deals 30000 HP damage.

evidence.quote:
defeating the Dark King...Yeah, you can easily deal 30000 HP damage by just casting Cure on
            him.

subject: Behemoth
text: Pound the Behemoth with regular attacks on the Hill Of Destiny.

evidence.quote:
Hill Of Destiny...Suddenly, a Behemoth will appear out of
nowhere...Since
regular attacks are really your only option at this point, just pound it with
that.

subject: boulder
text: In Level Forest, jump over the blue guy with the B Button to push the boulder up.

evidence.quote: Level Forest...talk to the blue guy a bit to the north. That boulder is blocking his way...Use the B Button to jump over him. Simply push it up
